name: Read-only navmesh-guided normal walk to original Vilverin camp baseline

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local goal=util.vector3(53450,86100,289)
local path=nil
local index=1
local timer=0
local age=0
local last=self.position
local stuck=0
local attempts=0
local function route()
 local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=100}})
 print('VilverinCampPath query status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#p)
 if #p>0 then local endp=p[#p];local d=endp-goal;if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<110 then path=p;index=1;attempts=attempts+1;print('VilverinCampPath ready points='..#p);return end end
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 age=age+dt;timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;local elapsed=timer;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original camp arrival')
 if core.isWorldPaused() or age<3 then return end
 local finish=goal-self.position
 if math.sqrt(finish.x*finish.x+finish.y*finish.y)<90 then
  local n=0;for _,id in ipairs({{0x6c2aa,0x6c2ab}}) do local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id));if obj and obj:isValid() then print('VilverinCamp reference present='..id) else n=n+1 end end
  print('VilverinCamp baseline missing='..n..' cell='..self.cell.name..' pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current);return
 end
 if not path then route();return end
 local progress=(self.position-last):length();last=self.position
 if self.controls.movement>0 and progress<1 then stuck=stuck+elapsed else stuck=0 end
 if stuck>3 then print('VilverinCampPath replan');path=nil;stuck=0;assert(attempts<12,'Camp path blocked repeatedly');return end
 while index<=#path do local v=path[index]-self.position;if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<14 then index=index+1 else break end end
 if index>#path then path=nil;return end
 local v=path[index]-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 print(string.format('VilverinCampPath aim x=%d y=%d point=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5))),index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,finish:length()))
 if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('VilverinCampPath facing') end
end}}}}
